name: project
description: Project chain: init (product brief), architecture (drivers, capacity, ADRs), spec (Spec Kit phased specification), docs (documentation site), status (where the pipeline stands, what to run next), recap (where the last Claude Code or OpenCode session left off and what changed since), checkpoint (a git-excluded hand-off file another account or session resumes from), pitch (the project's presentation page, sized and pitched for its audience); for existing code: survey (first-contact overview), introspec (reverse-engineered spec), retrofit (upgrades with behavior frozen), refactor (redesign with core invariants kept)

holdsBand.title: Checkpoint holds band
holdsBand.description: Show the holds recorded in .ai-gent/checkpoint.md above the prompt

holdsGate.title: Ask before a push, merge, tag or release under a hold
holdsGate.description: While the checkpoint lists holds, ask before git push, git merge, git tag, gh pr merge or gh release create

pipelinePane.title: Pipeline pane
pipelinePane.description: The /pipeline-pane pane: the pipeline's artifacts, feature statuses and open items, and what to run next; it opens by itself when specs/README.md exists on a surface that can dock it

pipelinePollSeconds.title: Pipeline pane refresh (seconds)
pipelinePollSeconds.description: How often the open pane checks the files for changes

bandCap.title: Most bands above the prompt
bandCap.description: At most this many bands draw above the prompt, chosen by priority (1 to 5); the rest are listed by /bands. A band that holds something is never hidden

bandsCommand.title: /bands command
bandsCommand.description: The /bands command: every active band above the prompt, with its priority and whether it is shown

handoffNudge.title: Hand-off nudge
handoffNudge.description: Toast, once, that the checkpoint is behind and to run /project:checkpoint when the context is nearly full, before a compaction, or (with token_report.py beside the plugin) when a usage cap runs low

handoffNudgeContextPercent.title: Hand-off nudge: context used (%)
handoffNudgeContextPercent.description: Nudge when the context window is at least this full

handoffNudgeCapPercent.title: Hand-off nudge: cap left (%)
handoffNudgeCapPercent.description: Nudge when a usage cap in .ai-gent/budget.yaml has less than this share left (needs token_report.py beside the plugin)
